column9: Changed meaning of disclosure - payment disclosureDetails: (03:58 - 04:03) During the payment disclosure the agent provided the incorrect last four digits of the payment method while she was scheduling a payment. The agent said â€œI want to confirm that you authorize a firm to debit your bank account ending in 7951 in the amount ofâ€¦â€. However, the correct last 4 digits are 7952. Therefore, due to the digits being incorrect stated the meaning of the disclosure was changed.When we change what a disclosure is saying by omitting or adjusting wording, we are leaving the customer to interpret the terms of the disclosure, which can create issues if the disclosure makes a statement that is different from what we are saying. Disclosures contain several terms that customers must be aware of and agree to prior to action being taken. When not stated, customers can object to or dispute specific things that result from our actions such as being charged bank fees, or falling overdue.

The information provided by the agent (02:44-02:53) was incorrect because we cannot guarantee that the cs will receive a full refund due to it depends on the merchant policies, meaning that this is a speculation about the result of the dispute. The agent SHOULD have provided the Refund talking points:Refund talking points should be given so the customer knows our policies and how a refund will impact their loan. - We should inform the customer that "returns/refunds are subject to the merchant's policy. Refunds can take 3-5 business days to appear on the Affirm loan from the date the merchant processed the refund. Furthermore, the customer is still responsible for payments until a Full refund is applied resulting in a $0 balance. Affirm would recommend making payments on the loan to keep it up to date. If you are given a full refund after payments are made Affirm will refund you payments made to your payment method used, less any accrued interest within 3-10 business days depending on the financial institution. If the merchant provides a partial refund, depending on the amount, and how many payments are left in your payment schedule, you may have a lower final payment, fewer payments overall, or both. Affirm will not, however, adjust each installment based on the new loan balance after a partial refund is made.â€
